# Country Sourdough Loaf (2 kg final dough)

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Strong bread flour | 1000 g | 100% |
| Water (24 °C) | 720 g | 72% |
| Ripe sourdough starter | 200 g | 20% |
| Fine sea salt | 20 g | 2% |

# Country Sourdough Loaf (2 kg final dough)

## Method
1. Mix the flour and water and rest for a 45 minute autolyse.
2. Add the salt after the autolyse, then work in the starter and mix until smooth.
3. Bulk ferment for 4 hours at 24 °C, giving the dough three coil folds at 30 minute intervals.
4. Shape the dough, proof overnight in the fridge for 12 hours, then bake at 250 °C with the lid on for 20 minutes and lid off for 25 minutes.

# Country Sourdough Loaf (2 kg final dough)

## Allergen note
Contains wheat gluten.

# No-Knead Fermented Focaccia

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Bread flour | 500 g | 100% |
| Water | 400 g | 80% |
| Olive oil | 25 g | 5% |
| Fine sea salt | 7 g | 1.4% |

# No-Knead Fermented Focaccia

## Method
1. Dissolve the 7 g of fine sea salt in the water before adding the flour.
2. Mix to a sticky dough, then give four stretch-and-folds over 90 minutes.
3. Rest the dough in a well-oiled pan for 2 hours until it is puffy.
4. Dimple the surface, drizzle olive oil, and bake at 230 °C for 25 minutes.

# No-Knead Fermented Focaccia

## Allergen note
Contains wheat gluten.

# Fermented Jalapeño Hot Sauce

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Jalapeño peppers | 800 g | 100% |
| Water | 200 g | 25% |
| Fine sea salt | 30 g | 3.75% |
| Garlic cloves | 40 g | 5% |

# Fermented Jalapeño Hot Sauce

## Method
1. Blend the peppers, garlic and salt with the water and pour into a ferment jar.
2. Ferment for 5 days at 21 °C, burping the jar daily.
3. Blend and strain the mash, then measure the pH.
4. The pH must read below 3.8 before bottling; keep the bottled sauce refrigerated.

# Fermented Jalapeño Hot Sauce

## Allergen note
None.

# Baechu Kimchi

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Napa cabbage | 1200 g | 100% |
| Coarse sea salt | 60 g | 5% |
| Water (for brine) | 900 g | 75% |
| Gochugaru | 45 g | 3.75% |
| Garlic | 30 g | 2.5% |
| Ginger | 15 g | 1.25% |
| Soy sauce | 20 g | 1.67% |

# Baechu Kimchi

## Method
1. Quarter the cabbage and salt it for 2 hours, then rinse twice.
2. Make a paste from the gochugaru, garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
3. Massage the paste between every leaf and pack the jar tightly.
4. Ferment 3 days at room temperature, then move to the fridge.

# Baechu Kimchi

## Allergen note
Contains soy.

# Sourdough Baguettes

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Bread flour | 850 g | 100% |
| Water | 620 g | 73% |
| Ripe sourdough starter | 170 g | 20% |
| Fine sea salt | 17 g | 2% |

# Sourdough Baguettes

## Method
1. Mix all ingredients to a shaggy dough and rest for 30 minutes.
2. Give three coil folds over a 3.5 hour bulk ferment at 24 °C.
3. Divide the dough into 4 pieces of about 415 g each.
4. Shape each piece into a baton, proof for 45 minutes, then slash.
5. Bake at 250 °C with steam for 12 minutes, then 12 minutes dry.

# Sourdough Baguettes

## Allergen note
Contains wheat gluten.

# 24-Hour Fermented Pizza Dough

## Ingredients
| Ingredient | Weight | Baker's % |
|---|---|---|
| Caputo 00 flour | 600 g | 100% |
| Water | 420 g | 70% |
| Sourdough starter | 120 g | 20% |
| Fine sea salt | 18 g | 3% |

# 24-Hour Fermented Pizza Dough

## Method
1. Mix the flour, water, starter and salt until no dry flour remains.
2. Give four folds during a 2 hour bulk ferment at 24 °C.
3. Ball the dough and cold ferment for 24 hours in the fridge.
4. Bring the dough to room temperature for 2 hours before stretching by hand.

# 24-Hour Fermented Pizza Dough

## Allergen note
Contains wheat gluten.
